records.title: Link cut in STEERING: B4 RTL at 10 s
records.criterion: HOLD <= 3 s (helm), then RTL 10 s (+/- 1 s) after the link is cut (B4), and the boat heads home

events: BOATY B4 LINK LOST IN MANUAL: RTL

records.title: Link cut in AUTO
records.criterion: Mission continues; RTL 60 s (+/- 1 s) after the link is cut (B4)

records.title: GNSS failure 5 s then restore
records.criterion: Motors stop <= 3 s after the fix is lost (B6 HOLD); RTL once the position has been healthy for 10 s
notes: RTL comes 10 s after B6 sees a healthy position, which includes the EKF's own recovery after the fix returns.

records.title: Drag released after burst 2
records.criterion: Stuck -> HOLD; B5 astern bursts (<= 0.5 m/s, <= 2 s); weed clears during burst 2; mission resumes; <= 3 bursts

records.title: Permanent weed: three bursts then HOLD + alarm
records.criterion: Exactly 3 bursts, then HOLD with a 'still stuck' alarm, and nothing restarts the motors

records.title: Kill the whole mission computer mid-mission
records.criterion: With B1-B7 dead (and so the bank link), the helm completes the mission, returns and holds within 5 m of home

records.title: Moisture flagged
records.criterion: RTL <= 2 s after the moisture sensor trips; alarm raised; IF-03 health shows fault

events: BOATY B6 WATER IN BOX: RTL

records.title: Persistent breach (wind pushing out)
records.criterion: Offshore gale: B7 stops the motors before 30 s outside or 10 m outside, and they stay stopped (detector recorded)

events: BOATY B7 HEADING CHECK FAILED: HOLD

notes: In a gale that blows the boat backwards the first-motion heading check fires first (course and heading 180 deg apart). The outcome, motors off, is what FEN-006 wants; the diagnosis is wrong.

records.title: Single motor failure
records.criterion: Right motor dead mid-leg: HOLD within 20 s (from whichever detector fires first), the boat stays inside the fence and ends in HOLD with an alarm
notes: A dead motor looks like 'stuck' to the helm's crash check, so B5 tries its astern bursts before giving up. Safe, but B5 cannot tell weed from a dead motor.

records.title: First-motion heading check
records.criterion: Compass reversed before the start: HOLD <= 10 s after AUTO begins; the boat stays inside the fence

events: BOATY B7 HEADING CHECK FAILED: HOLD

records.title: Reduced RTL speed at critical battery
records.criterion: After the critical battery failsafe, B6 slows RTL to 0.6 m/s (+/- 0.1) and raises an alarm

events: BOATY B6 CRITICAL BATTERY: SLOW RTL

records.title: Photos during a mission
records.criterion: Burst of 3 within 0.5 s of reaching photo point 2; interval photos every 5 s in AUTO; every photo geotagged within 3 m of the boat's true position

records.title: Battery drain to 35% then 15%
records.criterion: RTL at 35% (+/- 2%); critical alarm at 15%; reaches home within 5 m
notes: Reduced speed at 15% is not native (see V-15); it belongs to the mission computer in slice 2.

records.title: Link cut in STEERING: helm part
records.criterion: HOLD <= 3 s after the link is cut (FS-002 relaxed to 3 s by CR-05; the RTL at 10 s is B4: SC-02b)

records.title: GNSS failure 5 s then restore
records.criterion: Motors stop <= 3 s after the fix is lost (the RTL after 10 s healthy is B6, slice 2)
records.known_finding: Finding: EKF failsafe stops motors ~9 s after GNSS loss; FS-004 asks 3 s. Needs B6 fix-loss HOLD.
records.failure:
AssertionError: motors still running 3 s after GNSS loss
assert (62.807499999951 is not None and (62.807499999951 - 53.655833333292655) <= 3.0)

records.title: Status snapshot after connect
records.criterion: Link up, disarmed, 3D fix, EKF healthy, home set

records.title: Parameter baseline matches the controlled file
records.criterion: Every parameter in boaty-mk1.parm and sitl.parm exists on Rover 4.7.1 with the file's value

records.title: Fence and mission upload, read-back and verify
records.criterion: Read-back equals what was sent; verify() rejects a different mission

records.title: Uploads refused while armed
records.criterion: upload_fence/upload_mission/set_param raise NotAllowedWhileArmed

records.title: Arming lands in HOLD, never MANUAL
records.criterion: After arm(): armed, SRS mode HOLD, motors off

records.title: hold/return_home/manual/start_mission map to the IF-02 mode table
records.criterion: Each call reaches the right ArduPilot and SRS mode

records.title: drive() moves the boat in MANUAL
records.criterion: Throttle 0.6 for 5 s moves the boat > 2 m forward

records.title: STOP from AUTO: motors off and disarmed
records.criterion: Helm commands the motors to neutral <= 1 s after stop(); helm disarmed; stop() is idempotent
notes: Measured at 5x speed-up, so wall-clock latency in the test harness counts 5 times over; spin-down is the model's 0.1 s motor time constant.

records.title: Fence is enforced in the mode used for MANUAL
records.criterion: Driving straight at the fence in STEERING for 60 s: the boat reaches the fence area but never gets more than 10 m outside
notes: Rover's fence avoidance (AVOID_*) holds the boat short of the fence line in MANUAL, so the breach action is a second layer.

records.title: GCS failsafe can 'continue in AUTO'
records.criterion: Link cut in AUTO for 20 s: mode stays AUTO and the mission keeps progressing

records.title: Boat loiters at home at the end of RTL
records.criterion: After arriving home in RTL, with a 4 m/s wind for 60 s, the boat stays within 5 m of home
notes: ArduPilot stays in RTL and station-keeps for boats; Mission Control must show 'arrived' as HOLD (MOD-005).

records.title: Crash check can meet FS-005 (stuck detection)
records.criterion: Heavy weed drag in AUTO: HOLD within 5 s of the boat being stuck (< 0.1 m/s)
records.known_finding: Finding: native crash check resets on any noisy GNSS speed sample; stuck-to-HOLD varies 4.9-20 s. Needs B7 second stuck detector (A-07).

records.title: Helm counts only Mission Control heartbeats as GCS
records.criterion: With Mission Control silent but the mission computer (1/191) heartbeating, the GCS failsafe still fires

records.title: A second system-255 heartbeat masks the GCS failsafe
records.criterion: Shows why C7 must refuse to operate when a foreign system-255 source appears
notes: Expected: the failsafe does NOT fire, because ArduPilot accepts any system-255 heartbeat. Mitigation is FM-41 / SC-37 in Mission Control (slice 3).

records.title: GUIDED stops within 3 s if velocity targets stop
records.criterion: After the last velocity target, motors are off within 3 s
notes: Rover 4.7.1 mode_guided.cpp: 3 s timeout, then a decelerating stop (ATC_DECEL_MAX).
records.known_finding: Finding: GUIDED times out after 3 s then decelerates; motors off ~3.9 s.

records.title: Skid-steer boat frame behaves plausibly
records.criterion: Flies the 30 m triangle: cross-track RMS <= 3 m, mean speed within 20% of 1.0 m/s

records.title: Second voltage input gates arming (key in/out)
records.criterion: Rail reads < 9 V: arming refused with a battery-2 reason; rail restored: arming works

refusal: Arm: Battery 2 below minimum arming voltage

notes: SITL cannot switch its second analogue input off, so key out is emulated by scaling BATT2_VOLT_MULT; the real switch is tested on L2 (L2-13).

records.title: Native mechanism to stop motors on persistent breach
records.criterion: Offshore gale pushes the boat out: does ArduPilot itself stop the motors by 30 s / 10 m outside? (answer recorded)
notes: Answer: NO native stop - ArduPilot keeps fighting in RTL. FEN-006 must be met by B7/B-services (slice 2).

records.title: Reduced speed during RTL on critical battery
records.criterion: Answer recorded: RTL speed after the critical battery failsafe, compared with WP_SPEED (1.0 m/s)
notes: Answer: NO native speed reduction: FS-001's reduced speed at 15% must come from the mission computer (slice 2).

records.title: GNSS-velocity yaw fallback when the compass disagrees
records.criterion: Single compass rotated 90 degrees mid-mission: the boat never leaves the fence (it may HOLD); heading error recorded
notes: Finding: with its only compass rotated, the EKF heading stays wrong (no GSF yaw reset, no message), yet the boat still tracks its mission on GNSS course. Heading-dependent outputs (photo tags, map arrow) would be wrong; B7's heading-vs-course check (A-03, SC-38) is what catches it.

records.title: Does the helm refuse fence changes while armed?
records.criterion: Answer recorded; our helm API refuses regardless
notes: FEN-007 is enforced by C7 (NotAllowedWhileArmed) whatever ArduPilot does.
